description:
Advances: ancora.tasks

Severity: Medium (calibrated), with one High. Consolidated findings F11, F12, F30, F35, F36, F37, F50, F51, F52, plus the tracked F18 and F19. ancora is 1.0.0 on hex, so each of these is now a compatibility promise.

F18 (High, was tracked) — the --json payload changes SHAPE by failure path and carries no version key. The env payload (gate.ex:46-63) has no branch key and no guidance key; the branch payload (gate.ex:361-387) has no message key. Neither is a subset of the other, so a consumer reading report -> branch -> changed_files nil-derefs the first time origin/main is not fetched, which is this tool most common CI failure. Adding a version key and one builder is additive but it is an output-contract change on a published 1.0.0 and needs a matching ancora.tasks requirement pinning the payload the way finding_line_format pins the human lines. Treat as a 1.0.1 decision.
F19 (was tracked) — hexdocs publishes 50 modules against a two-function promise (Ancora.Parser.parse_file/2 and Ancora.DecisionParser.parse_file/2). Decide what the library API actually is, including whether Ancora.check/2 and Ancora.validate/2 join the commitment given validate/2 already has an external caller, and record it in README and the corpus rather than only in mix.exs.

F11 — spec.init and spec.decision.new bypass Output.gated/2 in violation of ancora.tasks.gated_emission_paths, and spec_decision_new_test.exs:35 PINS the violation with assert_raise Mix.Error. Route both through gated/2, change the test to the gated shape, and tag one of the two to gated_emission_paths.
F12 — cut the always-exit-0 clause from report_task_flags and let status_derived_report own the exit tiers; the two requirements currently contradict each other about whether spec.status can exit non-zero.
F30 — document in README.md and docs/migration.md that CI must pass --base explicitly and that default_base is a local-development convenience. The ship proved why: on a push event the workflow fell back to the repo default branch and compared the trunk against an orphan board branch.
F30b (folded in from ancora-8t2, 2026-09-03) — fix the push path in .github/workflows/ci.yml as well as documenting it. The default branch is main now, so the orphan-branch failure is gone, but the fallback base_ref="${PR_BASE_REF:-$DEFAULT_BRANCH}" now makes every push-to-main and workflow_dispatch run diff origin/main against itself: an empty range, a vacuous pass. main is not branch-protected, so this is the only run that would ever catch a direct push. Decision: on push events use github.event.before as the base, guard the all-zeros sha GitHub sends on branch creation by skipping the smoke step for that run, and keep pull_request on origin/${{ github.base_ref }}. Nothing in lib/ changes for this; it is a few lines of YAML. 8t2 verified the shape locally: with p47 applied, spec.check --base 5d9cb40 (what github.event.before would have been for the post-merge push) ends result=pass.
F35 — document the --json extraction rule: the report is the LAST stdout line that parses as JSON, and the verdict follows it. Change the head-of-list extraction in the tests to last-parseable-line. Note --json emits plain text and zero JSON on the usage path (output.ex:203-211); the env tier was taught to emit JSON in 1.0.0 and usage was left behind, with nothing testing it.
F36 — add moduledocs to spec.review, spec.init and spec.decision.new, and an Options section to all eight tasks listing each flag, its argument and its default.
F37 — drop sanitize/1 from json_payload/1 and narrow the property test to assert the JSON line does not match the verdict grammar, which is the property that matters.
F50 — drop the unconditional info-hidden suffix from the finding_line_format grammar and say which of the three counts are totals.
F51 — define --since and its precedence over --base in next_labels_verbatim, or reject the combination as a usage error.
F52 — add spec.review --root and --spec-dir and the three tasks short aliases to report_task_flags. Making aliases consistent across all eight is a flag-surface change and is deliberately NOT taken here.

Deliberately dropped by the review, do not relitigate: --debug is accepted by spec.check and spec.validate and does nothing. A specified no-op boolean on a dev CLI harms nobody, and removing an accepted flag is a break that would also need the requirement amended.

Ruling needed before code moves (Manuel): (F18) does 1.0.1 add a version key and one payload builder so every --json exit path shares one shape? (F19) what is the committed library API: parse_file/2 on Parser and DecisionParser only, or also Ancora.check/2 and Ancora.validate/2?
Recommended default from the ticket: F18 yes, additive: one builder, a version key, env/branch/usage/ok payloads as one superset shape, pinned by a new ancora.tasks requirement the way finding_line_format pins the human lines. F19: commit the two parse_file/2 functions plus Ancora.validate/2 (it already has an external caller) and Ancora.check/2, and say so in README, the corpus, and mix.exs docs groups.
Worker: if no comment on this ticket records a ruling when you start, park and ask. Do not choose on Manuel's behalf and do not implement more than one option.

Verification:
- Tests to pass: tagged tests under ancora.tasks in test/mix/tasks/** and test/ancora/output*_test.exs; test/ancora/gate_test.exs for the payload builder; test/mix/tasks/spec_decision_new_test.exs rewritten from assert_raise Mix.Error to the gated shape and tagged to gated_emission_paths; test/ancora/static/exactly_eight_test.exs untouched here (ancora-xla.7 owns it)
- Behaviors to demonstrate: (1) --json on ok, env, branch, and usage paths emits one JSON line of the same versioned shape, extracted as the LAST stdout line that parses as JSON, with the verdict after it; (2) spec.init and spec.decision.new run inside Output.gated/2; (3) report_task_flags no longer contradicts status_derived_report about spec.status exit; (4) README and docs/migration.md say CI must pass --base explicitly and default_base is a local convenience; (5) every one of the eight tasks has a moduledoc and an Options section listing each flag, argument, and default; (6) sanitize/1 is gone from json_payload/1 and the property asserts the JSON line does not match the verdict grammar; (7) finding_line_format drops the unconditional info-hidden suffix and names which counts are totals; (8) --since precedence over --base is defined or rejected; (9) spec.review --root and --spec-dir and the three short aliases are in report_task_flags; (10) ci.yml smoke step uses github.event.before on push events, skips on the all-zeros sha, and keeps the PR base on pull_request; the PR run for this ticket is itself the pull_request proof, and the worker records in the IMPLEMENTED comment the exact base the push branch would use
- Verification cadence:
  - Iteration tier: mix test --stale or explicitly named test files, plus mix spec.validate; no full suite mid-iteration.
  - Final tier: immediately before IMPLEMENTED, run-until-green: mix compile --warnings-as-errors && mix test && mix format --check-formatted && mix deps.unlock --check-unused && mix spec.check --base the epic base sha recorded at admission
  - Verifier tier: mix spec.check --base the epic base sha recorded at admission plus tagged and --stale selections only; do NOT run the full suite.
- Standing bounce-class checks:
  - Production call site named for each new callable surface, with the proving test that exercises that production path.
  - Fixture hygiene: one TmpGitRepo per test, no shared temp dirs, async only where the fixture allows.
  - Spec surfaces kept fresh for every touched callable surface. Drift, growth, and shrink clear only through substantive requirement or scenario edits in the same diff, never through a Spec-Ack trailer.
  - Every conditional clause covered by a test.
- proves: every --json exit path emits one versioned payload of the same shape, and every task goes through the gated emitter.

Allowed touches (this ticket may modify):
- lib/mix/tasks/**, lib/ancora/output.ex, lib/ancora/output/verdict.ex, lib/ancora/gate.ex (payload builders), lib/ancora/init.ex, lib/ancora/task_args.ex, lib/ancora/next.ex, lib/ancora.ex
- mix.exs (docs groups and package description only; no dep or version change)
- README.md, docs/migration.md
- .github/workflows/ci.yml (smoke step base derivation only; no job, matrix, or trigger changes)
- test/mix/tasks/**, test/ancora/output*_test.exs, test/ancora/gate_test.exs, test/support/**
- .spec/specs/ancora.tasks.spec.md (new json payload must, report_task_flags, next_labels_verbatim, finding_line_format, gated_emission_paths; substantive)
- .spec/specs/ancora.gate.spec.md (acknowledgment edits only: substantive requirement/scenario updates that clear drift/growth/shrink for this ticket's own changes; never weakening a must)

- Any spec whose stated rule THIS ticket's change makes false, for the sole purpose of correcting that statement in the same diff. Recorded after ancora-v1n shipped a corpus holding two scenarios that predicted opposite outcomes from identical input, because the spec stating the old rule was withheld from its Allowed list and the worker retagged around the conflict instead of flagging it. If you find a requirement anywhere in .spec/ that your change falsifies, fixing it here is in scope and expected. Say so in your completion record.

- .spec/decisions/** (added 2026-09-03 by the orchestrator, third instance of the same admission defect, this one found by the ancora-xla.4 verifier. Ancora.PolicyFiles.missing_decision?/1 at lib/ancora/policy_files.ex:115 fires change/missing_decision whenever any path under .spec/specs/ changes without an accompanying decision-record change in the SAME diff. Every ticket here is required to edit a spec, so this finding is structurally guaranteed and the decision-record edit is forced rather than optional. Write a real contract statement describing what you actually built; do NOT add a hollow line to silence the finding, which a grader will read as finding-silencing and bounce.)

Out of Scope (files):
- lib/ancora/review/**
- lib/ancora/derive/**
- lib/ancora/parser.ex
- lib/ancora/verifier.ex
- VERSION, CHANGELOG.md (the release PR owns these)

Out of Scope (intent):
- no removal of the accepted --debug flag (dropped by the review)
- no making short aliases consistent across all eight tasks (explicitly not taken)
- no env-tier routing changes (ancora-xla.2); consume its payload shape, do not rewrite it

Merge gate:
- [ ] mix compile --warnings-as-errors
- [ ] mix test
- [ ] mix format --check-formatted
- [ ] mix deps.unlock --check-unused
- [ ] mix spec.check --base the epic base sha recorded at admission ends result=pass
- [ ] Scope check: diff touches only Allowed globs (mechanical)
- [ ] Auditor APPROVE comment on the ticket
